title: M365 Copilot Usage Reports Watch
blurb: A running record of the Microsoft Learn pages behind the Microsoft 365 admin center Copilot usage and readiness reports — the adoption and activity data source several of the Hub's adoption and readiness reports read from. Changes to these reports change what adoption signal is available to analysts.
